title: Corpus black-box runtime fails ABI 0.2 adj/compute baselines
description: Dialect §21.1 sentence: "the trace runtime and harness at ABI 0.2 (bd -566)". corpus/legality/cases/spec-sem2-adj.ll and spec-sem2-compute.ll use ABI 0.2 (adj(f,budget,env), compute(f,use,budget,env)). The opaque harness baseline and independent opt/llc builds WITHOUT bennett exit 87 on LLVM 18 and 23, as do post-plugin O0/O3. This rules out the plugin as the origin. Upstream b-dialect-spec-566 must update the trace runtime and harness to ABI 0.2; the plugin gate counts these as blocked-upstream: bp-c2i, never agreements. The gate preserves per-cell pre/post exit evidence. No sibling runtime, checker or interpreter source was read.
